bio.text: Susan DuBose, a Republican, has represented District 45 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
She was born in Biloxi, Mississippi, earned a B.S. in finance from the University of South Alabama in 1985, and holds an M.B.A. from Spring Hill College.
Her career experience includes working as a commercial lending officer with Compass Bank.
